name: Kimi K2.8 Preview
short: No such Moonshot model could be verified as of 2026-10-20 - Moonshot's model list, pricing, changelog, docs index, HF org, models.dev, OpenRouter and Zen all lack a K2.8; negative record, self-excluded report.
contextWindow: Unverified - no published figure (1M was claimed but never confirmed)
pricingNote: No published price - Moonshot's API is pay-as-you-go per token; no K2.8 line exists on any price sheet
standout: A verified absence: the slot between K2.7 Code and K3 that never shipped, kept so the gap is auditable.
tradeoff: Nothing to adopt - use Kimi K2.7 Code (262K, MIT weights) or Kimi K3 (1M) instead.
